subject.title: feat(agents)!: remove the stored default agent — sole agent or explicit ownership

question: Should `AgentSelectionRequiredError`, sole-agent resolution helpers, and `AgentSelectionContext` become supported public plugin SDK APIs, or should this PR keep the ownership implementation behind existing plugin contracts?
rationale: The branch introduces an externally importable ownership-selection API through a public barrel that current main labels deprecated; choosing a permanent plugin compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep ownership helpers internal
options.body: Remove the new broad-barrel exports and adapt bundled plugins through an existing focused contract or a narrowly designed internal seam.

options.title: Approve a focused public SDK contract
options.body: Retain the helpers only after documenting their intended external-plugin semantics, compatibility policy, and focused contract coverage.

options.title: Pause the API portion
options.body: Land no public SDK expansion until a separate plugin API proposal establishes the supported ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Keep ownership helpers internal
recommendation.body: Remove the new broad-barrel exports and adapt bundled plugins through an existing focused contract or a narrowly designed internal seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged history and this branch show steipete carrying the roster and ownership design across the affected runtime and migration boundaries.
